newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nat Foods refuses comment on report.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nat Foods refuses comment on report.

text.p: Food group National Foods Ltd said on Thursday it had no comment on a report in The Australian newspaper it was about to announce the A$200 million sale of its National Pak packaging division as part of a wider shake-up.
National Foods said in a statement to the stock exchange referring to the report that it had previous signalled its intention to review the performance of all its assets.
"Unfortunately in such circumstances speculation and rumours about the company's future plans are inevitable," it said.
"It is not, and has never been, National Foods' policy to comment on press or market speculation and rumour."

The Australian said National Foods would announce the sale soon. "The sale of National Pak and its Glad cling wrap and plastic garbage bag brand to the U.S. First Brands Inc will be greeted with initial enthusiasm by the share market," it said.
"The sale is struck at a generous multiple of 10 times earnings before interest and tax and will represent a one-off profit of more than A$50 million," the newspaper said.
National Foods' shares were unchanged at A$1.45 at 12.30 p.m. (0130 GMT).
